report: V9 end-to-end performance and memory benchmark
measured_at_utc: 2026-11-04T18:00:00Z/2026-11-04T18:35:00Z (approximate wall clock of the measurement session; host clock reads 2026-11-04)
provenance_note: The measurement and assembly tools listed under source_sha256 were uncommitted when the runs executed; the digests below identify the exact files that produced these numbers. Prior evidence under reports/performance/<timestamp>Z/ is retained unchanged as branch history and is cited by directory.

host.note: Mac measurements are not Linux VPS measurements. Every reported benchmark ran inside the ARM Linux container described under container, not on bare macOS.

dataset.checksum_verification: each archive verified against its vendor .CHECKSUM sidecar before use (shasum -a 256 -c): 60/60 OK
dataset.not_used: no data outside the development window, no sealed out-of-sample data, no synthetic data in any reported timing or memory row

measurement_method.baseline: fresh child process per repetition, timed by a parent via resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN; includes interpreter startup, output and teardown; excludes the parent's own measurement file write
measurement_method.memory_sampling: parent samples /proc/<pid>/statm, status and stat about every 100 ms; median observed gap 0.101 s, max 0.110 s
measurement_method.warmup: the first process in a fresh container is measurably slower (4.29 s vs 2.79 s for the same B1 workload); it is retained as the max of the B0/B1/B3 triples and called out as cold-start
measurement_method.instrumented_runs: sys.monitoring stage trace, cProfile and tracemalloc runs are reported separately and never used as baseline timings
